signalTypes.definition: A specific competitor pricing comp is requested.
Auto-populated by benchmark-staleness-sweep; refresh existing benchmark.
Broad capture across pricing + packaging + retention; multiple scans.
Comp CAC / conversion / payback for a channel.

evidenceRules: Tailwind references must be cited or flagged `tailwind-uncited`.
Mixed external data stays conflicting; do not average into a fake clean number.
If source access is blocked, raise `capability-gap`; do not invent.

actionSelection.drop: Duplicate / out of scope / low-leverage. Delete the queue entry.
actionSelection.observe: Single-snapshot fact below the materiality threshold. Retag queue entry to `monetization-benchmark-record/<slug>`; no decision.
actionSelection.promote-to-canon: Scan crosses the materiality threshold. Retag entry plus raise `benchmark-update` / `pricing-decision` / `financial-model-assumption-update`.
actionSelection.file-decision: Decision-only outcome (e.g., assumption invalidated, no new scan). Raise the decision; delete the queue entry.
actionSelection.capability-gap: Source / tool / scenario missing. File `capability-gap`; leave the queue entry until the gap is closed.

materialityThresholds.pricing-tier-1: move >15% on Vrooli's tier-1 target band
materialityThresholds.retention-or-churn: move >5 percentage points on the comparable cohort
